name: Shaoxing Wine
description: Aged Chinese rice wine from Zhejiang with a nutty, amber depth used in cooking and sipped warm in winter.
ingredients: a handful of fresh cilantro, chopped
instructions: Combine the glutinous rice and chicken stock in a saucepan, blender, or pitcher, stirring well.
Add the chili oil and Shaoxing wine, stirring gently so their flavor infuses the mixture.
Heat gently over low heat (or blend, or steep, depending on the drink) until well combined and fragrant, about 5 mins.
Strain through a fine sieve to remove any solids, if needed.
Sweeten to taste with black vinegar, adjusting gradually until the balance feels right.
Chill in the refrigerator, or pour straight over ice, depending on whether it is served cold or hot.
Garnish with cilantro just before serving.
tips: Adjust the sweetness gradually, tasting as you go — you can always add more black vinegar, but you cannot take it away.
Make a big batch and keep it chilled in the fridge — the flavor often deepens after a few hours.
Serve in a chilled glass for the most refreshing result on a hot day.
